claims.claim: The person had a tax credits award before tax credits ended.
claims.quote: You’ll get a letter called your Annual Review when your tax credits award ends.
claims.note: The page addresses people whose tax credits award ended.

claims.claim: The person has an Annual Review letter to check.
claims.quote: You’ll need to check that the information in the letter is correct (known as ‘finalising’ your tax credits).
claims.note: The page says to check the Annual Review letter.

claims.claim: A claimant can finalise the Annual Review by phone.
claims.quote: To make their Annual Declaration when they get the form they can either phone the Helpline and complete the Annual Declaration over the phone
claims.note: The manual allows an Annual Declaration by phone, but it does not identify that older declaration process as the final Annual Review after tax credits ended.

claims.claim: A claimant can finalise the Annual Review by post.
claims.quote: complete the Annual Declaration and return it in the envelope provided.
claims.note: The manual allows returning an Annual Declaration by post, but it does not identify that older declaration process as the final Annual Review after tax credits ended.
